يحتقرون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَقِرُونَ (yaḥtaqirūna) /jaħ.ta.qi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# يُحْتَقَرُونَ (yuḥtaqarūna) /juħ.ta.qa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
